title: Cavern Reese
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A roaring detuned Reese bass in the mid register, built from a sawtooth split into a slow-beating jux copy and an off-tuned echo so the grain churns. A ladder filter, fm growl, and dual pan LFOs drift the voice across a wet, cavernous reverb over a 16-cycle morph.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<f2 f2 ab2 [c3 eb2]>*4").s("sawtooth")
    .detune(sine.slow(11).range(0.12, 0.42))
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(1.5, 7)).fmh("<1 1.5 2 0.5>/4")
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(320, 2600)).resonance(15).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2.5).lpattack(0.01).lpdecay(0.18)
    .attack(0.006).decay(0.22).sustain(0.6).release(0.08)
    .shape(0.32)
    .jux(rev)
    .off(0.013, x => x.add(note(0.15)).gain(0.5).pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.1, 0.9)))
    .pan(sine.slow(13).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .room(0.7).roomsize(6).delay("0.4:0.375:0.6").orbit(2)
    .gain(0.85)
)
